rationale: A social offer followed by a short water confirmation should become one physical delivery request; Soridormi resolves an unspecified source from the observed scene.

primary_outcomes: Offer practical help for thirst without starting unrequested body Work on the first turn.
After the user accepts water, request one physical water acquisition and delivery to the user, with source resolution left to Soridormi.
acceptable_auxiliary: The first response can be a brief question about water.
forbidden_semantic_outcomes: Treat the word water in the second turn as a current-turn location citation.
Ask the user for coordinates that the provider owns, or claim delivery without provider evidence.
Choose a water target without a scene observation.

description: Short water confirmation inherits the social offer and lets the provider find the resource.

turns.text: I am a little thirsty, can you help me?

memberships.title: Robust Intent Understanding
memberships.general_rule: Chromie should preserve ordinary human meaning across discourse markers, short fragments, ASR-like noise, Chinese and English input, and follow-up context.
memberships.rationale: The second turn is an acceptance of the offer, not a fresh unspecified question or a source-location statement.
